g.title: Sheet.112
g.desc: VLANs were introduced as a way to segment networks at Layer 2...
g.text: VLANs were introduced as a way to segment networks at Layer 2. Cisco was one of the first to popularize VLANs in enterprise networks.

g.title: Sheet.113
g.desc: ISL (Inter-Switch Link) was developed as a Cisco proprietary ...
g.text: ISL (Inter-Switch Link) was developed as a Cisco proprietary VLAN tagging protocol. It allowed switches to carry traffic for multiple VLANs over a single trunk link.

g.title: Sheet.148
g.desc: IEEE 802.1Q, the industry-standard VLAN tagging protocol was ...
g.text: IEEE 802.1Q, the industry-standard VLAN tagging protocol was developed. Unlike ISL, it allowed vendor interoperability and was widely adopted.

g.title: Sheet.201
g.desc: Cisco PVST (Per-VLAN Spanning Tree) was introduced shortly af...
g.text: Cisco PVST (Per-VLAN Spanning Tree) was introduced shortly after the development of ISL (Inter-Switch Link).

g.title: Sheet.202
g.desc: Cisco introduced PVST+ to support 802.1Q trunking. It become ...
g.text: Cisco introduced PVST+ to support 802.1Q trunking. It become the standard Cisco STP variant for VLAN-aware networks.
